title: Consolidate Brand, UI, and production design authority
outcome: Preserve one canonical Brand profile, keep UI as a mechanically pinned specimen laboratory, and keep Cave authoritative for production component behavior.
non_goals: Treating a design mock or specimen as production behavior.
Removing historical evidence before consumers migrate.

workstreams.responsibility: Own the sole normative visual identity, voice, and versioned public-web profile.
Consume an immutable Brand profile and remain explicitly noncanonical for production behavior.
Own production component behavior and downstream acceptance evidence.
Extract non-duplicative work and retire its canonical claim after consumer migration.
Record cross-repository resolution, dependency, and administrative protection gates.

exit_criteria.statement: Brand exposes one versioned normative public profile.
UI pins and verifies the Brand profile without claiming production authority.
Useful design-system work is migrated with provenance and duplicate authority is retired.
Required reviews and checks protect canonical Brand and production UI paths.

authority_boundary: This initiative coordinates responsibility and evidence. It does not grant protected identity, authorization, runtime, persistence, release, publication, or GitHub-administration authority.
